question: How do I enable automatic subtitles or transcription in kMeet?
perfect_answer: To enable automatic transcription/subtitles in kMeet: 1) Start the kMeet app (Web, desktop, or mobile). 2) Create or join a meeting room. 3) Grant access to at least your microphone. 4) Click on the action menu (three dots) in the toolbar. 5) Click on 'Enable subtitles'. 6) What is said by participants will be displayed at the bottom of your kMeet window. 7) To stop displaying the transcription, click the menu again. Note: If the moderator enables subtitles, then all participants (even users without kSuite or anonymous) will be able to activate the feature.
api_response:
To enable automatic subtitles or transcription in kMeet, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must be in a kMeet meeting.
- The moderator must enable subtitles for all participants to use the feature.

### Steps to Enable Subtitles:
1. Start the kMeet app (Web, desktop, or mobile).
2. Create or join a meeting room.
3. Grant access to at least your microphone.
4. Click on the **○○○** icon in the toolbar.
5. Click on **Enable subtitles**.
6. The transcription of participants' statements will be displayed at the bottom of your kMeet window.
7. To stop displaying the transcription, click again on the **○○○** icon and select **Disable subtitles**.

### Important Notes:
- If the moderator enables subtitles, all participants, including anonymous users, can activate the feature.
- The transcription is displayed in real-time during the meeting.

### Related Actions:
- If you encounter issues, refer to the troubleshooting guide for kMeet: [Troubleshooting Guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2441).

Source: [Transcribe a kMeet meeting in real-time (automatic subtitles)](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1431/transcribe-a-kmeet-meeting-in-real-time-automatic-subtitles)

question: How do I join an existing kMeet meeting?
perfect_answer: To join a kMeet meeting: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or from the desktop/mobile app. 2) Click the button to 'Join a Meeting'. 3) Enter the meeting code (e.g., 001-0002-003) or its link (which you can also open directly). 4) Click the OK button. 5) Authorize access to your webcam and microphone if needed. 6) Enter a pseudonym or your name. 7) Adjust settings (e.g., disable camera). 8) Click the blue button to join. 9) If needed, enter the access password and/or encryption key provided by the organizer. Tip: The meeting creator can share the link by clicking the user icon with a plus sign.
api_response:
To join an existing kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must have the meeting code or link provided by the meeting organizer.
- If required, you must have the access password and/or encryption key.

### Steps to Join:
1. Open kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or use the kMeet app on your computer or mobile device.
2. Click the button to **Join a Meeting**.
3. Enter the **meeting code** (e.g., `001-0002-003`) or the **meeting link** (you can also open the link directly).
4. Click the **OK** button.
5. If prompted, authorize access to your webcam and microphone from your browser or the app.
6. Enter your **pseudonym** or **first and last name**.
7. Adjust your settings, such as enabling or disabling your camera.
8. Click the blue button to join the meeting.
9. If required, enter the **access password and/or encryption key** provided by the meeting organizer.

### Important Notes:
- If the meeting organizer has enabled participant control, you may need to wait for approval before joining.
- Ensure your browser or app has the necessary permissions for the webcam and microphone.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2473/join-a-kmeet-meeting).

question: How can I use the whiteboard or drawing feature in kMeet?
perfect_answer: kMeet has two drawing features: 1) COLLABORATIVE WHITEBOARD: Start the kMeet desktop app, create/join a meeting with other users present. Click on the action menu (three dots) in the toolbar. Click 'Display the whiteboard'. The drawing surface is displayed to all participants, each can write, and each participant's cursor is visible. 2) DRAW ON SCREEN SHARE: Prerequisites: Have the kMeet desktop app and share your ENTIRE screen (not just a window). When a participant shares their screen, others can click the pencil icon in the bottom toolbar to draw on the screen share. You can modify the stylus color. Note: If screen share is not from the kMeet desktop app, participants cannot draw on it.
api_response:
### How to Use the Whiteboard or Drawing Feature in kMeet

#### Display a Collaborative Whiteboard
1. **Prerequisites**:
   - You must be in a kMeet meeting room with participants.
   - You need the kMeet desktop app (macOS, Windows, or Linux).

2. **Steps**:
   - Start the kMeet desktop app and create or join a meeting room.
   - Once in the meeting, click the action menu (**○○○**) in the kMeet toolbar.
   - Select **Display the whiteboard**.
   - The whiteboard will appear for all participants, and everyone can draw or write on it.
   - Each participant's cursor is visible on the whiteboard.

#### Draw on a Screen Share
1. **Prerequisites**:
   - You must have the kMeet desktop app (macOS, Windows, or Linux).
   - You must share your entire screen, not just an application window.

2. **Steps**:
   - Start the kMeet desktop app and create or join a meeting room.
   - One participant must start a screen share (desktop app only).
   - To draw on the shared screen:
     - Click the pencil icon in the bottom toolbar.
     - Modify the stylus color if needed.
   - If the screen share is not started from the kMeet desktop app, participants will see a message indicating that the drawing feature cannot be enabled.

#### Important Notes:
- The drawing feature is only available in the desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux).
- To allow participants to draw on a screen share, you must share the entire screen, not just a specific window.
- The whiteboard and drawing tools are collaborative, meaning all participants can interact simultaneously.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2620/draw-on-kmeet).

question: How can I remotely control another participant's computer in kMeet?
perfect_answer: To remotely control another user's computer in kMeet: Prerequisites: Have the kMeet desktop app (macOS/Windows) and share an ENTIRE screen (not just a window). Steps for user A to control user B's computer: 1) Start the kMeet desktop app and create/join a meeting where both users A and B are present. 2) User A clicks on the action menu (three dots) at the top right of user B's thumbnail. 3) User A clicks 'Start remote control' (same path to stop). 4) User B receives a notification to validate and accept the device control request. You can also simply annotate a screen share without taking control.
api_response:
To remotely control another participant's computer in kMeet, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must be a moderator in the kMeet session.

### How to Use:
1. Start a kMeet session and ensure you are the moderator.
2. During the session, you can request or grant remote control access to another participant's device.
3. The participant must accept the remote control request for it to work.

### Important Notes:
- Remote control is only possible if the participant consents to it.
- This feature is useful for troubleshooting or collaborative work during the meeting.

For more details, refer to the [official guide on remotely controlling a device with kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2622).

question: How do I sign a PDF document in kDrive?
perfect_answer: To sign a PDF in kDrive: 1) Access the kDrive web app at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Open the relevant PDF document. 3) Click the 'Edit' button at the top of the document. 4) Click the 'Signature' icon in the toolbar. 5) Click 'Add a signature'. 6) Choose creation method: Draw freehand with the mouse, Type text and choose cursive font, or Import an image (e.g., scan of handwritten signature). 7) Click 'Save'. 8) Click the Signature icon again to display your saved signatures. 9) Click a signature to insert it (it's transparent). 10) Move and resize as desired. 11) Save changes and choose to create a copy or overwrite the existing file. Note: Files are never analyzed and are exclusively stored in Switzerland.
api_response:
To sign a PDF document in kDrive, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must have access to the kDrive web app.
- The document must be in PDF format.

### Steps to Sign a PDF Document:

1. **Access kDrive**:
   - Go to the [kDrive web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).

2. **Open the PDF Document**:
   - Navigate to the relevant PDF document and open it.

3. **Enter Edit Mode**:
   - Click the **Edit** button at the top of the document to access the file editor.

4. **Access the Signature Tool**:
   - Click the **Signature** icon in the toolbar.

5. **Create a Signature**:
   - Click **Add a signature**.
   - Choose how to create your signature:
     - Draw freehand with the mouse.
     - Type text and choose a cursive font.
     - Import an image (e.g., a scan of your handwritten signature) from your device.

6. **Customize the Signature**:
   - If typing text, enter the desired text and click the **Aa** button to choose a handwriting style.
   - Click **Save** to store your signature.

7. **Insert the Signature**:
   - Click the **Signature** icon again to display your saved signatures.
   - Click on the signature to insert it into the document.

8. **Adjust the Signature**:
   - Move and resize the signature as needed.

9. **Save the Document**:
   - Once finished, save the changes.
   - Choose whether to **create a copy** of the modified document or **overwrite** the existing file.

### Important Notes:
- Your files are never analyzed and are exclusively stored in Switzerland.
- The kDrive web app natively integrates an editor for signing PDF documents online.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1463/sign-a-pdf-document-on-the-kdrive-web-app).

question: How do I restore a file to a previous version in kDrive?
perfect_answer: To restore a file to a previous version in kDrive: 1) Access the kDrive web app at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Navigate to the desired file. 3) Right-click on the file. 4) Click 'Version History'. 5) The different versions are listed in reverse chronological order. For each version, you can: Download the file in its state at that date/time, Keep it indefinitely (beyond standard retention), Create a new file from this version, or Delete just that version. You can delete all versions using the button. You can also access all versions of all files from the left menu 'Manage storage space' > 'File versions' dropdown. Note: You can keep certain versions indefinitely. Infomaniak keeps a backup of all changes made to files.
api_response:
To restore a file to a previous version in kDrive, follow these steps:

### Steps to Restore a File to a Previous Version:
1. Access kDrive:
   - Go to the [kDrive Infomaniak Web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).
2. Navigate to the desired file:
   - Browse through the kDrive directory to locate the file you want to restore.
3. Open Version History:
   - Right-click on the file.
   - Select **Version History** from the context menu.
4. View and manage versions:
   - The versions are listed in reverse chronological order.
   - For each version, you can:
     - Download the file as it was at that specific date/time.
     - Keep the version indefinitely (beyond the standard retention period).
     - Create a new file from this version.
     - Delete the specific version.

### Additional Information:
- **Accessing All File Versions**:
  - You can view all versions of all your files by going to the left menu and selecting **Manage storage space**.
  - Then, open the dropdown menu and choose **File versions**.

- **Restoring the Entire kDrive**:
  - If you need to restore the entire organization of your files, refer to the guide on [restoring kDrive to a previous state](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1838).

### Prerequisites:
- No specific role is required to restore a file to a previous version, but you must have access to the file.

### Technical Specifications:
- Infomaniak keeps a backup of all changes made to files on kDrive.
- You can choose to keep certain versions indefinitely.

### Important Notes:
- Files permanently deleted from the trash and deleted file versions cannot be restored.
- Restoration actions do not affect permissions and shares.

For more details, you can refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2384/restore-a-kdrive-file-to-a-previous-version).

question: How can I search for files within kDrive?
perfect_answer: To search for files in kDrive: ON MOBILE APP: Use the search field on the main page or tap the magnifying glass at top right when browsing folders. ON WEB APP: Use the search bar at the top (keyboard shortcut CMD-F or CTRL-F). Results display as you type. You can search by file type. Click 'advanced search' icon at the bottom of the dropdown to filter by: location, document type, modification date, created by (user), text in file/folder name, text in file content, or category. ENABLE CONTENT SEARCH: Go to Settings > General > Intelligent Features. Click to accept automatic file analysis. Enable the 'content search' toggle. This allows intelligent search within PDF files and text/spreadsheet documents.
api_response:
You can search for files within kDrive using the following methods:

### On the kDrive Mobile App (iOS/Android)
- **Search Field**: On the main page of the kDrive app, there is a search field where you can enter the text you want to find.
- **Magnifying Glass**: While browsing folders, a magnifying glass icon is visible at the top right of the screen. Tap it to start a search.

### On the kDrive Web App (Online Service)
- **Search Bar**: The search bar is always located at the top of the screen. You can use the keyboard shortcut `CMD-F` or `CTRL-F` to quickly focus on the search field.
- **Advanced Search**: Click on the advanced search icon at the bottom of the search bar dropdown menu to filter results by:
  - Location
  - Document type
  - Modification date
  - Created by (kDrive user)
  - Text visible in the file or folder name
  - Text in the file content itself
  - Category

Once you have set your search criteria, click the **Search** button to start the search.

### Enable Search Within Hosted Content
To enable intelligent content search within PDF files or spreadsheet/text documents:
1. Access the kDrive web app.
2. Click on the **Settings** icon in the top right corner.
3. Select the relevant kDrive in the dropdown menu of the left sidebar.
4. Click on **General** in the left sidebar.
5. Click on **Intelligent Features**.
6. Accept the automatic analysis of files.
7. Enable content search by clicking the toggle switch.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2320/search-for-data-on-kdrive).

question: How do I view and manage my kDrive storage space?
perfect_answer: To view and manage kDrive storage: 1) Access the kDrive web app at ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Click the chevron to expand 'kDrive Management' in the left sidebar. 3) Click 'Storage space'. 4) Select large files or file versions using the dropdown menu (file versions also count toward storage). 5) Click the action menu above your selection to delete them. TO INCREASE STORAGE: 1) Click 'Dashboard' under 'kDrive Management'. 2) Click 'Manage'. 3) Click 'Change Offer' to modify storage capacity. Note: Maximum number of files per kDrive is not a fixed limit, but exceeding it may affect stability. There are also bandwidth limits per day/user and max file size limits depending on upload method.
api_response:
### How to View and Manage Your kDrive Storage Space

#### **Viewing Storage Space**
To view and manage your kDrive storage space, follow these steps:

- **Access kDrive**:
  1. Go to the [kDrive web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).
  2. Expand the **kDrive Management** section in the left sidebar.
  3. Click on **Storage space** to view your current storage usage.

- **Filter and Manage Files**:
  4. Use the dropdown menu to filter large files or file versions (which also count toward storage).
  5. Select files and use the action menu (**⋮**) to perform actions like deletion.

#### **Increasing Storage Space**
To increase your kDrive storage:

  - You must have sufficient permissions within your Organization.

- **Steps**:
  1. Go to the [kDrive web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).

#### **Additional Features**

question: How can I scan documents with the kDrive mobile app?
perfect_answer: To scan documents with kDrive mobile app: Prerequisites: Have a kDrive or kSuite offer and install the kDrive mobile app. Steps: 1) Launch the kDrive mobile app on iOS or Android. 2) Press the icon at the bottom. 3) Press 'Scan a document'. 4) Authorize requested accesses if needed. 5) Document detection is automatic when the image is stable. 6) You can switch to Manual mode and trigger the photo yourself. 7) Crop the document if needed after manual photo. 8) Press 'KEEP' at top right. 9) Press thumbnail at bottom left for advanced editing (rotation, black and white) or to delete a page. 10) Press 'Finish' at top left. 11) Repeat for more pages or press 'Save'. 12) Multi-page scans are grouped into a PDF. Single images can be saved as JPG. 13) Choose save location on kDrive. The document syncs to all connected devices.
api_response:
To scan documents using the kDrive mobile app, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must have a [kDrive](https://infomaniak.com/gtl/ksuite.kdrive) or [kSuite](https://infomaniak.com/gtl/ksuite) subscription.
- Install the kDrive mobile app on your iOS or Android device.

### Steps to Scan Documents:
1. Launch the **kDrive** mobile app on your iOS or Android device.
2. Tap the **icon** at the bottom of the screen.
3. Select **Scan a document**.
4. If prompted, authorize the app to access your camera.
5. The app will automatically detect and scan the document when the image is stable.
6. You can switch to **Manual** mode to take the photo yourself.
7. Crop the document if necessary after taking the photo.
8. Tap **KEEP** to save the scan.
9. Tap the thumbnail at the bottom left to edit (rotate, convert to black and white, etc.) or delete a page.
10. Tap **Finish** to complete the scan.
11. Repeat the steps to scan additional pages or tap **Save** to store the document.

### File Format and Storage:
- If your scan contains multiple pages, it will be saved as a **PDF**.
- If there is only one page, you can choose to save it as a **.JPG** file.
- The scanned document will be saved to your kDrive and accessible on all your connected devices.

### Platform Availability:
- This feature is available on both **iOS** and **Android** devices.

For more details, refer to the [official guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2395/scan-with-the-kdrive-mobile-app).

question: How do I connect to kDrive via WebDAV?
perfect_answer: To connect to kDrive via WebDAV: FIND YOUR kDRIVE ID: Go to ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive, the URL will contain your ID (e.g., /drive/123456/). Use https://[IDkDrive].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com as the server address. ON WINDOWS: Open File Explorer > This PC > Computer tab > Add a network location > Choose custom network location > Enter server address > Use your Infomaniak email as username and create an application password. ON macOS: Finder > Go menu > Connect to server > Enter server address > Connect > Enter email and application password. ON LINUX (Gnome): Open Files > Network > Enter davs://[IDkDrive].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com > Enter credentials. You can also use software like RaiDrive (Windows) or Cyberduck (Windows/macOS). WebDAV allows using kDrive with third-party apps (like Joplin) or accessing from the OS file manager. Not all offers support WebDAV.
api_response:
To connect to kDrive via WebDAV, follow these steps:

### Prerequisites:
- You must have a kDrive account.
- Not all kDrive offers are WebDAV compatible. Check your offer's compatibility before proceeding.

### Steps to Connect on Windows:
1. Open **File Explorer** from the taskbar or the Start menu.
2. Select **This PC** in the left pane.
3. In the **Computer** tab, select **Add a network location**.
4. Click **Next**.
5. Click **Choose a custom network location**.
6. Click **Next**.
7. Enter the server address: `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com` (replace `IDkDrive` with your kDrive ID).
8. Click **Next**.
9. For the account settings, use the following information:
   - **Server address**: `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com`
   - **Username**: Your email address to log in to your Infomaniak account.
   - **Password**: Create an application password for this specific use.
10. Optionally, save the login information.
11. Enter a name for this connection or leave the default indication.
12. Click **Finish**.
13. Two folders will appear: one for deleted files and folders, and the other with the name of your kDrive containing your data.

### Obtain the kDrive ID:
1. Access the [Infomaniak kDrive web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).
2. The URL displayed at the top of your browser will contain a number after `/drive/`. For example, in `https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive/app/drive/123456/`, the kDrive ID is `123456`.
3. Use this ID to form the WebDAV server address: `https://123456.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com`.

### Connect with Third-Party Software (e.g., Cyberduck):
1. Open **Cyberduck**.
2. Go to **Bookmark** and select **New bookmark**.
3. Choose the **WebDAV (https)** protocol.
4. Provide the following details:
   - **Server address**: `https://IDkDrive.connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com`
   - **Username**: Your email address for your Infomaniak account.
   - **Password**: Create an application password for this specific use.
   - **Download folder**: The folder where downloaded files will be stored.

### Important Notes:
- Infomaniak does not provide support for the WebDAV protocol. It is recommended to use the official kDrive application to avoid file loss.
- WebDAV allows you to use third-party applications or access kDrive from your operating system's file manager.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2409/connect-to-kdrive-via-webdav-get-the-kdrive-id).

question: What are the different folder types in kDrive (personal, shared, common)?
perfect_answer: kDrive has 3 main folder types: 1) ORGANIZATION FOLDERS (Common): Shared automatically with certain or all users of the same kDrive. New folders here can be shared with entire Organization or specific users/teams who may need to request access. 2) MY FOLDER (Personal & Private): Each user has their own personal space NOT automatically shared with other kDrive users. 3) SHARES MENU: Contains 4 sub-menus - Elements shared with you by others, Elements you share with others, Elements you shared via public link, and Drop boxes. SECONDARY ELEMENTS include: My Favorites (files marked as favorites), My Latest Modifications (recent operations), Trash (deleted data that can be restored), and Categories (files organized by category). IMPORTANT: Do NOT rename or move default folders - this causes sync issues. You can set which page displays by default (personal folder, shared documents, or favorites) in Settings > General.
api_response:
In kDrive, there are three main types of folders:

### 1. **Organization Folders**
- **Purpose**: These folders are common to all collaborators within your Organization.
- **Sharing**: You can share a new folder with the entire Organization or restrict access to specific users or teams.
- **Access**: Users may need to request access if the folder is not shared with everyone.
- **Visibility**: The contents of these folders are visible to other kDrive users, but sharing can be restricted if needed.
- **Default Behavior**: These folders are automatically shared with certain or all users of the same kDrive.
- **Restrictions**: Users can force access to a subfolder if they have the necessary permissions, and this action will notify other users via email.

### 2. **My Folder (Personal & Private Folder)**
- **Purpose**: This is the default personal and private folder for each kDrive user.
- **Access**: This folder is specific to the user and is not automatically shared with other users.
- **Visibility**: The contents of this folder are private and not visible to other users unless explicitly shared.
- **Default Behavior**: Every kDrive user has their own personal space, and any documents in this folder will not be shared unless the user chooses to do so.

### 3. **Shared Folders**
- **Purpose**: These folders are used to share data with specific users or groups.
- **Sharing**: You can create folders with maximum sharing (visible to all kDrive users) or restricted sharing (visible only to authorized users).
- **Visibility**: Users with access to shared folders can see the contents directly. Other users may need to request access or force access if permitted.
- **Default Behavior**: Shared folders are available with certain paid offers and allow collaboration among users.

### Additional Notes:
- **User Permissions**: There are two levels of permissions for kDrive users:
  - **Administrator**: Has full rights, including sharing, statistics, restoring, and deleting folders.
  - **User**: Can access shared folders and manage their personal directory but cannot perform administrative tasks.
- **Restrictions**: The "Organization Folders" directory is common and visible to other kDrive users, but sharing can be restricted. Contents shared from a user's private folder are not listed in the "Shares" menu of other users.

For more details, refer to the [kDrive documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2410).

question: How do I manage deleted files and the trash in kDrive?
perfect_answer: To manage deleted files in kDrive: Files deleted from any synced tool go to the kDrive Web app trash. Files stay minimum 30 days, up to 365 days depending on offer. CONFIGURE TRASH RETENTION: Access Manager > kDrive > Trash in left sidebar > Settings > Choose duration (3 months, 6 months, 1 year). DESKTOP APP TRASH BEHAVIOR: Click kDrive icon > action menu > Application Preferences > Toggle whether deleting from Web/mobile puts synced file in computer's trash. RESTORE FROM TRASH: Go to kDrive > Trash in left sidebar > Select items > Click 'Restore' (to original location or location of your choice). IMPORTANT: If kDrive trash is emptied, recovery is impossible. Computer's OS trash is separate from kDrive Web app trash. Files may be permanently deleted instead of trashed if: insufficient space, or no trash on certain file systems (network/USB drives).
api_response:
### Managing Deleted Files and Trash in kDrive

#### Accessing and Managing the Trash
1. **Access the Trash:**
   - Go to the [Infomaniak Manager](https://manager.infomaniak.com/v3/ng/products/ksuite/kdrive).
   - Click on the name of your kDrive product.
   - Select **Trash** from the left sidebar to view deleted files.

2. **Configure Trash Retention Duration:**
   - Click on **Settings** in the Trash section.
   - Choose the desired retention duration (3 months, 6 months, or 1 year) from the dropdown menu.
   - Confirm your settings by clicking the **Confirm** button.

#### Restoring Files from the Trash
1. **Restore Files:**
   - Access the Trash as described above.
   - Select the files you want to restore.
   - Click on **Restore**.
   - Choose to restore the file to its **original location** or a **custom location**.

#### Important Notes
- **Restoration Options:**
  - You can restore an entire kDrive to its previous state if files have been moved or reorganized. Refer to [this guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1838) for more details.
  - To restore a previous version of an existing file, refer to [this guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2384).

- **Trash Accessibility:**
  - The Trash menu is accessible from the left sidebar in the kDrive Web app, allowing you to view and manage deleted files.

For more information, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2383/manage-kdrive-file-deletion).

question: How do I restore my entire kDrive to a previous state (rewind)?
perfect_answer: To restore kDrive to a previous state (Rewind): Prerequisites: Be Administrator or Legal Representative within the Organization. Steps: 1) Access kDrive web app. 2) Click Settings icon. 3) Select the relevant kDrive. 4) Click 'Restore'. 5) Read info and click to start. 6) Validate in the modal. 7) Choose what to restore (entire kDrive or part, and for which user). 8) Click Continue. 9) Choose the date to revert to (maximum 3 months/90 days). 10) Click Continue. 11) Launch analysis and review results. 12) Final security confirmation before restoration begins. IMPORTANT: Restoration may take several minutes during which kDrive is inaccessible to all users. Files permanently deleted from trash and deleted file versions CANNOT be restored. No actions are performed on permissions and shares. Conflicts are placed in a 'Restoration (date)' folder with 'Conflict' and 'Later Items' subfolders. Email notification is sent after completion.
api_response:
To restore your entire kDrive to a previous state (rewind), follow these steps:

### Prerequisites
- You must be an **Administrator or Legal Representative** within the Organization.

### Steps to Restore kDrive
1. Access the Infomaniak **kDrive** web app by clicking [here](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive).
2. Click on the **Settings** icon in the top right corner.
3. Select the relevant kDrive from the dropdown menu in the left sidebar.
4. Click on **Restore**.
5. Read the on-screen information and click the button to **start**.
6. Review the information in the modal and click the button to **validate**.
7. Choose whether to restore the entire kDrive or just a part of it (and specify the user if applicable).
8. Click on **Continue**.
9. Select the date to revert to (up to a maximum of 3 months or 90 days).
10. Click on **Continue**.
11. Launch the analysis to determine the next steps based on the proposed result.
12. Confirm the final security request before the restoration begins.

### Important Notes
- The restore or *Rewind* feature allows you to revert the file organization in your kDrive up to 3 months back.
- Files permanently deleted from your kDrive trash and deleted file versions **cannot be restored**.
- Restoration may take **several minutes**, during which **kDrive will be inaccessible** for all users, depending on the volume of data to be recovered.
- No actions are performed on permissions and shares during the restore process.

After the operation, an email is sent, and a notification is displayed on the online kDrive.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1838/restore-kdrive-to-a-previous-state).

question: How do I sync kDrive with a QNAP NAS?

Steps: 1) Log in to QNAP NAS administration interface (QTS). 2) Download and install HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync app if needed. 3) Open HBS 3. 4) Go to 'Sync' from the left menu. 5) Create a synchronization task (Two-way Sync Job). 6) Select 'WebDAV' from the list of Cloud providers. 7) Enter account parameters: Server address: https://[IDkDrive].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com, Username: your Infomaniak email, Password: create an application password. 8) Select local and destination folders. 9) Customize the task frequency. 10) Complete the wizard. question: How do I send and manage voice messages in kChat?
perfect_answer: To send voice messages in kChat: 1) Open kChat (Web, desktop, or mobile app). 2) Click the microphone icon in the message composition window. 3) Grant permissions if requested to access your audio interface. 4) Record your message. 5) Click the cross to delete or the checkmark to keep. 6) The message is not sent directly but added to your message - you can listen again, delete it, or add text. 7) Send the message. 8) The voice message appears in the conversation with its text transcribed automatically. TO LISTEN: Click the Play button to start, click again (Pause) to stop. TO DOWNLOAD: Click the action menu and select 'Start the download' to save to your hard drive.
api_response:
### How to Send and Manage Voice Messages in kChat

#### **Send a Voice Message**
To send a voice message in kChat, follow these steps:

1. **Access kChat**:
   - Open the [kChat Web app](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kchat) or use the **kChat mobile app** (iOS/Android) or the **kChat desktop app** (macOS/Windows/Linux).

2. **Record the Message**:
   - Click the microphone icon in the message composition window.
   - Grant permissions if prompted to access your microphone.

3. **Save or Delete the Recording**:
   - Click the cross (✗) to delete the recording.
   - Click the checkmark (✓) to save the recording.

4. **Review and Send**:
   - The saved voice message is added to your message. You can listen to it again, add text, or delete it before sending.
   - Once sent, the voice message appears in the discussion with an automatic transcription in text.

#### **Listen to a Voice Message**
To listen to a voice message in kChat:

1. Click the ▶ (Play) button to start listening.
2. Click the ⏸ (Pause) button to stop playback.

#### **Download a Voice Message**
To save a voice message to your device:

1. Click the action menu **⋮** (three dots) on the voice message.
2. Select **Download** to save the voice message to your hard drive.

---

#### **Prerequisites**
- You must have access to kChat (Web, mobile, or desktop app).
- Microphone permissions must be granted for recording.

#### **Platform Limitations**
- Voice messages can be sent and received on all platforms (Web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux).

#### **Technical Specifications**
- Voice messages are automatically transcribed into text.
- The transcription appears alongside the voice message in the discussion.

#### **User Role Requirements**
- Any kChat user can send, listen to, and download voice messages.

#### **Important Notes**
- Voice messages are stored securely on Infomaniak’s servers.
- You can add text or delete the voice message before sending it.

#### **File Types and Extensions**
- Voice messages are saved in an audio format (e.g., `.mp3`, `.wav`).

#### **Default Behaviors**
- Voice messages are automatically transcribed into text when sent.

#### **Related Actions**
- You can delete a voice message before sending it.
- You can download a voice message for offline use.

#### **How to Use**
- Use the microphone icon to start recording.
- Use the ▶ button to listen to a voice message.
- Use the **⋮** menu to download a voice message.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2876/manage-voice-messages-with-kchat).

question: How do I use emoticons and GIFs in kChat?
perfect_answer: To use emoticons and GIFs in kChat: ADD REACTION: Hover over any message > select an emoticon from the selection or click the smiley with '+' to open the full emoji panel. If there are already reactions, you can add one below the message. ADD EMOJI/GIF IN MESSAGE: Click the smiling face icon in the formatting bar > choose an emoji or switch to the GIF tab for animated GIFs. You can also type ':' followed by at least 2 characters to search emojis by name. TIP: Use #, ##, or ### at the start of a line with an emoticon for larger display (e.g., '# :smile:'). SET SKIN TONE: Click the skin tone symbol in the emoji panel. CUSTOM EMOTICONS: Click the button in the emoji panel to add custom emojis. Name up to 64 characters (lowercase, numbers, -, +, _). File can be .gif, .png, or .jpg up to 1MB. Auto-resized to 128x128 pixels. Custom emojis are available to all Organization users.
api_response:
To use emoticons and GIFs in kChat, follow these steps:

### Add a Reaction to a Message
- Hover over the message you want to react to.
- Select either:
  - An emoticon from the selection.
  - The smiley with the little "+" to open the emoji panel.
- If there are already reactions below the message, you can add yours in the same place.

### Express Yourself with an Emoticon or GIF
- Click the smiling face icon in the formatting bar of your message.
- Choose an emoji or insert a short animated GIF using the tab at the top of the emoji panel.
- Alternatively, type `:` followed by at least the first 2 characters of the emoji name (e.g., `:smile:`).

### Custom Emoticons
- Click the custom emoticons button in the emoji panel.
- Specify a name (up to 64 characters, using lowercase letters, numbers, `-`, `+`, or `_`).
- Upload a `.gif`, `.png`, or `.jpg` file (up to 1MB). The image will be resized to 128x128 pixels.
- The custom emoticon will be available to all users in your organization.

### Tips
- Use `#`, `##`, or `###` at the start of a line with an emoticon to display a larger emoticon (e.g., `# :smile:`).
- Set the default skin tone for human emojis by clicking the skin tone symbol in the emoji panel.

For more details, refer to the [official documentation](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1190/manage-emoticons-and-gifs-on-kchat).

question: How do I customize kChat settings and display?

question: How do I fix camera or video issues in kMeet?
perfect_answer: To fix camera/video issues in kMeet: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or the app. 2) Start a new meeting with a room name. 3) A popup should ask to authorize camera access - accept it. 4) If the popup doesn't appear, check the icons in your browser header. 5) Check browser settings (e.g., Chrome) to adjust authorization and camera selection if multiple cameras are available. PHYSICAL COVER CHECK: If your image is black while the camera is activated, check for a privacy cover. Many laptops have a small mechanical slider above the screen. Look for a red dot or opaque sticker on the lens - this means the cover is closed. Slide it sideways to unblock. Note: Since this is mechanical, no software setting will activate the image while the cover is closed.
api_response:
To fix camera or video issues in kMeet, follow these steps:

### **Authorize Camera Access**
1. Start kMeet via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or from one of the applications for computers or mobile devices.
2. Start a new meeting.
3. Specify a **name** for your meeting room.
4. A popup should appear asking you to authorize the browser to access your microphone and camera. Click **Allow**.
5. If the popup does not appear automatically, check the icons in the header of your browser and manually enable camera access.
6. Adjust the authorization settings and camera selection in your browser settings if multiple cameras are available.

### **Check Multimedia Permissions on Mobile Devices**
#### **iOS:**
1. Go to **Settings > Privacy & Security**.
2. Tap on a hardware feature, such as **Camera** or **Microphone**.
3. Ensure kMeet has the necessary permissions in the list of apps.
4. Go to **Settings > Privacy and Security > Security Control**.
5. Tap **Manage shares and access**, then follow the on-screen instructions to ensure no settings interfere with kMeet.

#### **Android:**
1. Open **Settings** on your phone.
2. Tap on **Apps**.
3. Find **kMeet** or tap **Show all apps**, then select kMeet.
4. Tap on **Permissions**.
5. Tap on a permission setting (e.g., Camera or Microphone) and select **Allow**.

### **Windows Troubleshooter for Audio/Video Issues**
1. Access **Windows Settings** and go to **Privacy**.
2. Ensure the following permissions are enabled:
   - "Allow apps to access the camera"
   - "Choose which Microsoft Store apps can access the camera"
3. Enable **Windows Search**, **Camera**, and **App Connector**.
4. For the microphone, follow the same steps.
5. If issues persist, use the **Audio Troubleshooter**:
   - Go to **Search** in the taskbar, type **Audio Troubleshooter**, and select **Find and fix problems playing sound**.
   - Select **Next**, choose the device to troubleshoot, and follow the prompts.

### **Join the Meeting from a Different Device**
If you encounter issues on one device, try joining the meeting from another device:
1. On the device with issues, invite a new participant to get the meeting link.
2. Open a web browser on the new device and enter the meeting link (e.g., *https://kmeet.infomaniak.com/* followed by the meeting code).
3. Alternatively, use the meeting code to join.

### **Additional Tips**
- Ensure your browser or kMeet app has the necessary permissions to access the camera and microphone.
- If using the kMeet desktop app, check your operating system's privacy settings to allow camera and microphone access.

For more details, refer to the official guides:
- [Fix an audio issue on kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2441/fix-an-audio-issue-on-kmeet)
- [Resolve a video issue on kMeet](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2452/resolve-a-video-issue-on-kmeet)
